title: Multiple Interactions between Host Cyclodextrin and Guest Compound Assisting Asymmetrically Selective Reduction with NaBH4 in Aqueous Media
abstract: Abstract                In the presence of 6-mono-deoxy-amino-β-cyclodextrin, benzoylformic acid was enantioselectively reduced with sodium borohydride in aqueous solution. The dependence of the optical yield on pH, ionic strength, cyclohexanol and urea suggested that the concerted host–geust interaction arose from both hydrophobic and ionic interaction as well as hydrogen bonding.
